# Portal 2 VR Mod

**Repository:** [github.com/jimgranitex-eng/portal2vr](https://github.com/jimgranitex-eng/portal2vr)

Open-source Portal 2 VR mod with motion controls, 6DoF, and zero-config setup.

- **Latest release:** v5.3.0 — July 24, 2026
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Platform:** Windows (SteamVR + Vulkan via DXVK)
